elegant habits that make
you look 10x more attractive

1. saying hello first.
greeting people warmly
before they greet you
shows ease, not need.

2. laughing at your own
mistakes.
not taking yourself too
seriously is quietly
magnetic.

3. always having something
to talk about.
a book, a painting, a piece
of history. learn one new
thing every day.
